description: List the dependencies of a specific crate version — what <crate> itself depends on. Returns each dependency with its version requirement, kind (normal/build/dev), optional flag, enabled features, and target. Version is optional (defaults to the latest stable). Use for "what does <crate> depend on", dependency audits, or sizing a crate's footprint.

version.description: Exact version (e.g. "1.40.0"), or omit for the latest stable.

name: get_crate_dependencies
title: Get Crate Dependencies
